name: CoA summons wear the area-of-effect avoidance their live counterparts show
contract: Live CoA combat logs (C:/CoA/SUB/old-logs, 2026-05) give each summon's damage from a creature's area spell as a ratio of the damage the players took from the same cast. Stock guardians with 32233 'Pet Avoidance' (aura 310 -90%, aura 229 -20%, x0.08) show 0.16-0.17. The CoA guardians and pets show 0.08-0.19 (Greater Skeletal Warrior 0.095, Greater Imp has no sample), so they get 32233. Abomination 50068 shows 0.042, matching 680927 'Avoidance' (aura 310 -95%, aura 229 -20%, x0.04). Spectral Scythe 250305 applies 500485 'Spectral Scythe Passive' to itself in the logs (aura 229 -90%). Serpent Ward 50105 and Mimic Ward 300659 show 0.012-0.013; 992173 'Mechanical Ward' (aura 229 -98%, x0.02) is the closest aura without side effects. Steps: 504901 'Raise: Greater Skeletal Warrior' -> 51065 (guardian), 500335 'Raise: Abomination' -> 50068 (guardian, 3 Life Force after 680283), 500576 'Spectral Scythe' -> 250305 (guardian), 500960 'Serpent Ward' -> 50105 (totem, outside Guardian::InitStatsForLevel) and 520661 'Summon: Greater Imp' -> 510100 (real pet). Expected: each summon wears its aura. Before the change none of them did.
